On this walk you read early medieval rock-cut iconography with a respectful evidence-led lens.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Harbour/ferry briefing and weather check
  • Island arrival and ascent
  • Accessible Cave 1 relief interpretation
  • Return ferry contingency

How the time is spent

  1. Harbour/ferry briefing and weather check 30 min

  2. Island arrival and ascent 60 min

  3. Accessible Cave 1 relief interpretation 65 min

  4. Return ferry contingency 25 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Interpret the reliefs in Cave 1 as early medieval rock-cut iconography of Shiva.
  • Read rock-cut iconography with a respectful approach led by the evidence.
  • Describe how the sculpted panels are arranged within the cave.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.

Where
Elephanta, Mumbai
For
Individuals, families, schools, colleges, private groups and visitors from abroad
Length
Half a day, plus the ferry
When
Tuesday to Sunday. The Elephanta Caves are closed on Mondays. Early morning is best in the warmer months.
Led by
A specialist in the subject, named in your quotation
Language
English, Hindi or both. Other languages on request, through our partners.
Group size
Agreed with you. Smaller and larger groups are welcome.
Meeting point
Agreed with you. A map location is shared once the date is confirmed.
What to bring
Comfortable shoes, water and a hat. The ground is uneven in places.
Entry fees
Monument entry fees, where charged, are not included.
Price
₹1,800 per person for 2, ₹900 each for 10 or more, including GST
